title: seismic-eval-audit: cross-dataset and ETHZ space-time metadata evidence
description: Metadata evidence extension using the unchanged seismic-eval-audit 0.1.3 wheel. Four complete SeisBench metadata snapshots comprise 515,692 records; 28 contracts are cross-checked. Includes scripts, exact input hashes, aggregate results and spatial/temporal sensitivity figures. Raw upstream metadata and record-level tables are excluded because uniform redistribution permission was not established. Regeneration requires upstream access to the exact hashed metadata. No model training or inference; author-run verification is not independent adoption. Original software and historical model archives remain unchanged.
